 Bihar School Holiday 2027: Students to get 20-day summer break, 8-day Chhath vacation; check full calendar
 Bihar School Holiday 2027: Students to get 20-day summer break, 8-day Chhath vacation; check full calendar
 Vishnukumar V | November 13, 2026 | 03:26 PM IST | 3 mins read
 The Bihar Education Department has announced 69 holiday days, including nine Sundays, for government schools in 2027. The calendar covers festivals, national holidays, summer vacation and winter break.
 Bihar has announced its holiday schedule for government schools for the 2027 calendar year. (Representative Image: Pexels) Government schools in Bihar will observe 60 holidays in 2027, excluding Sundays, while the state's annual holiday calendar lists a total of 69 days, including nine Sundays. The Bihar Education Department has released the holiday schedule for the 2027 calendar year, with a 20-day summer vacation from June 2 to 21 and a seven-day winter break from December 25 to 31.
The holiday calendar has been issued by the  Directorate of Secondary Education , Bihar, under the state Education Department. It applies to government, governmentised, project and upgraded primary, secondary and higher secondary schools. Sanskrit, Urdu and madrasa schools are also covered under the schedule.
According to the calendar, the 69 days include nine Sundays, leaving 60 holidays after excluding Sundays. The schedule includes national holidays, religious festivals, state-specific occasions and seasonal breaks.
The holiday list covers occasions such as Republic Day, Bihar Diwas, Holi, Eid-ul-Fitr, Ram Navami, Mahavir Jayanti, Eid-ul-Zuha, Buddha Purnima, Independence Day, Raksha Bandhan, Krishna Janmashtami, Durga Puja, Diwali, Chhath Puja and Guru Nanak Jayanti.
 Also read BBOSE Class 10, 12 timetable 2026 out at bboseonline.bihar.gov.in; theory exams start from December 9 
 Bihar school summer vacation 2027
 As per the official schedule, summer vacation will begin on June 2 and continue until June 21, 2027. The break will cover 20 days, including three Sundays.
 The summer vacation period will begin on Wednesday and end on Monday. It accounts for the longest continuous school break listed in the calendar.
 Bihar school winter vacation 2027
 The winter vacation will be observed from December 25 to 31, covering seven days. The break will include one Sunday, December 26.
 The winter vacation will begin on Saturday and end on Friday. The calendar lists Christmas Day, December 25, as the beginning of the winter break.

 Bihar School Holidays 2027: Festival-wise breaks
 The calendar provides holidays for several religious and cultural festivals during the year.
 Holi:  Schools will remain closed for two days on March 23 and 24, covering Tuesday and Wednesday.
 Eid-ul-Fitr and Eid-ul-Zuha: Eid-ul-Fitr will be observed as a holiday on March 10, while Eid-ul-Zuha (Bakrid) will fall on May 17.
 Durga Puja:  The holiday schedule includes October 1 for Kalash Sthapana, followed by a four-day Durga Puja break from October 6 to 9.
 Diwali and Chhath Puja:  Schools will have an eight-day holiday period from October 29 to November 5 for Diwali, Chitragupt Puja, Bhai Dooj and Chhath Puja. The period includes one Sunday.
 Other festivals:  The calendar also includes holidays for Maha Shivratri, Vasant Panchami, Ram Navami, Mahavir Jayanti, Buddha Purnima, Raksha Bandhan, Krishna Janmashtami, Hari Talika Vrat, Anant Chaturdashi, Jivitputrika Vrat and Guru Nanak Jayanti.
